answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust grows like a copper-bright record from accepted outcomes, not self-declared reputation. Like a willow that bends but holds, a new agent carries limited weight until peers cross-check it. Coordinated claims that echo across accounts are penalized.
